v: strI kf--BAve praSnAKyAnavizaye iY । praSnAKyAnavizaye 1 kriyAyAm । “kAM kArimakArzIH? sarvAM kArimakArzam” ityAdi । kf--karttari Silpini iY । 2 Silpini tri॰ ।
m: 1. कारि m. f. an artist, artificer, mechanic, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 152
कारि f. action, act, work (only used in questions), Pāṇ. iii, 3, 110.
2. कारि mfn. raising hymns of praise, VS. xxx, 6 and 20.
a: कारिः — f. Action, act, work. --m. An artist, a mechanic.

m: कारिका f. (f. of कारक), a female dancer, L.
a business, L.
trade, L.
concise statement in verse of (esp. philos. and gramm.) doctrines, MBh. ii, 453 &c.
torment, torture, L.
interest, L.
N. of a plant, L.
f. pl. or more commonly हरि-कारिकास्, the Kārikās of Bhartṛ-hari i.e. the verses contained in his gramm. work Vākya-padīya (q.v.)
a: कारिका — 1 A female dancer. --2 A business, or trade. --3 A memorial verse, or a collection of such verses, on grammatical, philosophical, or scientific subjects; e. g. Bhartṛhari's Kārikās on grammar; सांख्यकारिका. --4 Torment, torture. --5 Interest.

k.v: धेनुका तु करेण्वां च मेघजाले च कालिका। कारिका यातनावृत्त्योः कर्णिका कर्णभूषणे॥
धेनुका तु करेण्वां च मेघजाले च कालिका। कारिका यातनावृत्त्योः कर्णिका कर्णभूषणे॥

m: कारिका—निबन्ध m. N. of wk.
कारिकावली f. N. of wk.
1. कारिन् mfn. (Pāṇ. v, 2, 72) doing, making, effecting, producing, acting, an actor, Yājñ.; MBh. &c. (mostly ifc. ŚBr.; Mn. &c.)
(accord. to some in RV. also, कारिन्, ‘conquering, victorious’).
कारिन् m. a mechanic, tradesman, L.
2. कारिन् mfn. rejoicing, praising, RV.
3. कारिन् mfn. (fr. √ कॄ) scattering, destroying, Śiś.
a: कारिन् — a. Making, doing, causing, bringing about (at the end of comp). --m. A mechanic, artist.

s: strI, (kArita + wAp .) fRikena yA svakAryyasADakatayA aSItitamaBAgadvikaSatAdito'DikA vfdDirvyavasTApitA sA । aDik suda iti BAzA । yaTA, vivAdArRavasetO kAtyAyanaH ॥ “fRikena tu yA vfdDiraDikA saMprakIrttitA । ApatkAlakftA nityaM dAtavyA sA tu kAritA” ॥ (taTA ca manuH 8 । 153 । “nAti sambatsarIM vfdDiM na cAdfzwAM punarharet । cakravfdDiH kAlavfdDiH kAritA kAyikA ca yA” ॥) tatparyyAyaH । kArikA 2 kAritAvfdDiH 3 । iti mitAkzarA ॥
m: कारिता f. (scil. वृद्धि) forced to be paid, interest exceeding the legal rate of interest, Gaut. Comm. on Mn. viii, 153
कारितान्त mfn. ending with a Caus. affix, APrāt.

s: tri, (kf + Ric + karmmaRi ktaH .) kurvvan preritaH । karARa iti BAzA । yaTA, mArkaRqeye । devImAhAtmye 81 । 65 । “vizRuH SarIragrahaRamahamISAna eva ca । kAritAste yato'tastvAM kaH stotuM SaktimAn Bavet” ॥
v: strI kf--Rica--karmmaRi ktaH । 1 karaRAya prerite । “vizRuH SarIragrahaRamahamISAnaeva ca । kAritAste yato'tastvAm” devImA॰ । 2 aDamarRRena svakAryyasidDaye niyatavfdDeraNgIkftADikavfdDO strI “vfdDiH sA kAritA nAma yarRRikena svayaM kftA” mitA॰ nA॰ smftiH । “fRikena tu yA vfdDiraDikA saMprakIrttitA । ApatkAle kftA nityaM sA tu syAt kAritA matA” kAtyA॰ ।
m: कारित mfn. ifc. caused to be made or done, brought about, effected, Mn.; MBh. &c.
कारित n. the Caus. form of a verb, Nir. i, 13.
a: कारित — a. Caused to be done or effected. --ता Interest, the amount of which is fixed by the debtor (being forced to do so by the creditor). --तं The causal form of a verb.

m: कारित—वत् mfn. one who has caused to be made or done.
